answer: In PoA, each challenge commits to a future threshold-BLS beacon pulse whose unpredictable output is unavailable when agents must register or commit. A sybil swarm therefore cannot precompute a reusable answer set or farm challenges offline: only identities that later reveal a valid response bound to that pulse can score. The copper, falcon, and plume challenge classes may differ, but all inherit the same unbiased timing and verification rules.
